analysis.description: Opening subject and answer statements only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Foster's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The answer begins in m. 2 while the first statement is still sounding, forming a stretto. The bass entry begins in m. 5. The incipit preserves the quarter-note ties to sixteenths before each repeated sixteenth-note attack. Entry labels follow the literal score imitation without inferring tonal centres from transposition alone. Manual score transcription of opening subject and answer statements, checked against Dorothy Nell Foster (1973), Chapter IV. Quarter-note units; entry ends include the final note and all its written ties. Excerpts extend through the final subject release when it passes the exposition cadence. No recording timing has been estimated. A short independently engraved subject incipit is included; the source score, thesis prose and chart images are not redistributed.
